data.strFullDescription:
[p]This is a first-person simulation game where you step into the role of a tobacco shop owner.
[/p][p]Work alone or with friends to expand your humble shop into a huge tobacco shop.
[/p][p]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/77751ef58ec2f0c8895cd03529b49130.poster.avif?t=1777138855" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/77751ef58ec2f0c8895cd03529b49130.webm?t=1777138855" width="600" height="200"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Co-Op Mode and Single Player[/h2][p]Share the duties with your friends in co-op mode (for up to 4 players).
[/p][p]The more players in the store, the more demanding customers will visit your store.
[/p][p]Also, you can go solo and manage everything in the store. You can invite your friends anytime if you change your mind.
[/p][p]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/d44bdfb13ed100a98376407dad16a248.poster.avif?t=1777138855" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/d44bdfb13ed100a98376407dad16a248.webm?t=1777138855" width="600" height="200"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Store Workflow[/h2][p]Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products with an in-game computer or with your tablet while walking in the store, unpack the boxes, place the products into your store, and set the prices for your products.
[/p][p]Consider the market prices while setting up your product prices in the store for customer satisfaction.
[/p][p]Always keep your store clean so as not to lose any customers. Also, be careful with the thieves to avoid some box losses that would cause a leak in your finances.
[/p][p]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/ed144550ffcb2929e41d716840ad6cdd.poster.avif?t=1777138855" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/ed144550ffcb2929e41d716840ad6cdd.webm?t=1777138855" width="600" height="200"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Products[/h2][p]Please make sure your customers find all their needs in the store.
[/p][p]Always expand your product portfolio and satisfy your customers.
[/p][p]Cigarettes, lighters, pipes, cigars, ashtrays, hookahs, e-cigarettes, tobacco, and smoking accessories... [/p][p]Be aware of the market prices and purchase more products when they're cheap.
[/p][p]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/a24ba52ce59a66ae0030434c4e4e7df5.poster.avif?t=1777138855" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/a24ba52ce59a66ae0030434c4e4e7df5.webm?t=1777138855" width="600" height="200"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Customers[/h2][p]Place a sufficient number of checkouts to reduce the waiting time for customers.
[/p][p]Scan products and collect payments whether in cash or with card purchases.
[/p][p]Don't forget to fulfill the online orders.
[/p][p]
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/1cbbbb14f261055edbcf835336dfe39e.poster.avif?t=1777138855" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/1cbbbb14f261055edbcf835336dfe39e.webm?t=1777138855" width="600" height="200"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Expansions and New Teammates[/h2][p]Expand your store and warehouse by leveling up your store and budget.
[/p][p]Hire stockers to fill the racks.
[/p][p]Purchase more cash registers and hire new cashiers to minimize long queues at the checkouts and to reduce waiting time for customers.
[/p][p]
Hire a janitor to clean the store and hire a security guard to chase down the thieves.
[/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/565d92663364aad188d282ce8ca57c44.poster.avif?t=1777138855" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3211680/extras/565d92663364aad188d282ce8ca57c44.webm?t=1777138855" width="600" height="200"][/imgvid][/p]
data.strSnippet: Run your tobacco shop. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, hire workers, expand your store, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.
